response.text:
I can do that, but deleting calendar events is destructive so I need a few clarifications before proceeding.

Please confirm these details (or tell me any different preferences):

1. Date range — by “next week” do you mean Monday through Sunday of the next calendar week? If you prefer specific dates, give them.
2. Which calendar(s)? (e.g., Work, Personal, all calendars)
3. Scope — remove only "meetings" (events that have other attendees) or all events?
4. Action type — when you say “remove,” do you want:
   - Cancel the events (if you’re the organizer) and send cancellation notices to attendees, or
   - Remove/decline them from your own calendar without notifying others?
   Note: If you’re organizer, deleting without sending cancellations may leave invitees expecting the meeting.
5. Preview — do you want me to show a list of the meetings I’ll remove for your review before I delete them?
6. Time zone — confirm the time zone to interpret “next week” (I’ll use your account/timezone by default unless you specify otherwise).

If you’d like, I can also draft a short cancellation message to send to attendees (example: “I’m cancelling next week’s meetings due to schedule changes — I’ll follow up to reschedule.”).

Tell me your answers (or say “use defaults”), and I’ll proceed to show the preview before making any deletions.
